# volcenginecc_organization_delegated_administrator (Resource)

Delegated administrator account for the specified trusted service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcenginecc_organization_delegated_administrator" "example" {
  account_id        = "20222222222"
  service_principal = "resourtest"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Member account ID of the delegated administrator.
- `service_principal` (String) Trusted service identifier.

### Read-Only

- `account_name` (String) Member account name.
- `delegation_enabled_time` (String) Timestamp when the account was set as the delegated administrator.
- `display_name` (String) Member account display name.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `join_method` (String) Method by which the member joined the organization.
- `owner` (String) Organization owner account ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
$ terraform import volcenginecc_organization_delegated_administrator.example "account_id|service_principal"
```
